mapper.select:
SELECT SUM(count) AS totalRptCount FROM stat_mon_evt_rpt WHERE 1=1
AND stat_cycle =
CURDATE() DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN CURDATE() WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 6 THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 2) DAY) END
AND region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.regionCode}, '%')
AND cat_name = #{query.catName}

SELECT hour AS maxHour FROM stat_mon_evt_rpt WHERE 1=1
AND stat_cycle =
CURDATE() DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN CURDATE() WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 6 THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 2) DAY) END
AND region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.regionCode}, '%')
AND cat_name = #{query.catName}
GROUP BY hour ORDER BY SUM(count) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(hour, 2, '0'), ':', CASE WHEN minute = 0 THEN '00' WHEN minute = 15 THEN '15' WHEN minute = 30 THEN '30' WHEN minute = 45 THEN '45' END) AS time, SUM(count) AS count, (hour = (SELECT hour FROM stat_mon_evt_rpt WHERE 1=1
AND stat_cycle =
CURDATE() DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN CURDATE() WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 6 THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 2) DAY) END
AND region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.regionCode}, '%')
AND cat_name = #{query.catName}
GROUP BY hour ORDER BY SUM(count) DESC LIMIT 1)) AS isPeak FROM stat_mon_evt_rpt WHERE 1=1
AND stat_cycle =
CURDATE() DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN CURDATE() WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 6 THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 2) DAY) END
AND region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.regionCode}, '%')
AND cat_name = #{query.catName}
GROUP BY hour, minute ORDER BY hour, minute

SELECT a.region_name AS regionName, SUM(r.count) AS count, (SUM(r.count) / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM stat_mon_evt_rpt WHERE 1=1
AND stat_cycle =
CURDATE() DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN CURDATE() WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 6 THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 2) DAY) END
AND region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.regionCode}, '%')
AND cat_name = #{query.catName}
)) * 100 AS proportion, ((SUM(r.count) / (SELECT SUM(count) FROM stat_mon_evt_rpt WHERE 1=1
AND stat_cycle =
CURDATE() DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN CURDATE() WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 6 THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 2) DAY) END
AND region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.regionCode}, '%')
AND cat_name = #{query.catName}
)) * 100 > 30) AS isOverThreshold FROM stat_mon_evt_rpt r LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON r.region_code = a.region_code WHERE 1=1
AND r.stat_cycle =
CURDATE() DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN CURDATE() WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 6 THEN CURDATE() ELSE DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL (WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) + 2) DAY) END
AND r.region_code LIKE CONCAT(#{query.regionCode}, '%')
AND r.cat_name = #{query.catName}
GROUP BY a.region_name ORDER BY count DESC
